notes:
CRM snapshot: mid-market analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood after 6 weeks on hosted API. Wants to move to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. Short notes / call highlights:
- Workloads: 60% support-agent (low latency), 30% embeddings/semantic search, 10% offline reranking. Volume: ~120k conversations/month, peak concurrent 300 req/s for search batch windows.
- Targets: p95 response <250ms (chat), throughput 250 req/s sustained, cost-sensitive (target < $1200 per 1M tokens equivalent).
- Security: strict SSO/SAML + SOC2 required. Data residency EU preference for EU customers; global routing for other traffic.
- POC ask: 6-week Dedicated pilot, single customer VPC, reserved GPU pool + burst capacity. POC acceptance criteria: latency p95 <250ms, canary quality delta <3% vs hosted baseline, no failed TLS/KMS rotations, successful audit log capture.
- Canary plan (agreed verbally on 2026-02-18): start with 5% traffic to Dedicated canary for 48 hours, increase to 25% for 72 hours if metrics stable. Canary owners: Priya Nair + Ironclad infra lead (Martin Hale).
- Fallback / routing plan: primary -> dedicated-us-east1 (gpt-open-8b-quant), fallback 1 -> dedicated-us-west1 (gpt-open-4b-quant), fallback 2 -> hosted-us-east (redundant, lower-cost model). Auto-failover triggers: region loss, p95 latency >350ms for 2 consecutive 15m windows, or error rate >2%.
- Model variant strategy: use quantized 8B as main for latency/cost sweet spot; keep 4B variant for fallback and burst. Canary uses both variants in shadow for quality comparison (A/B via reranking eval).
- Rollback playbook: immediate rollback to previous model variant + region failover if quality regression >5% on held prompt set or latency SLA breached. Rollback controlled via Console feature-flag + automatic timeout 30m to clear canary if instability detected.
- Observability: need token-level cost breakdown, per-route p95, and per-model quality score tied to stored eval prompts. Requested 30-day retention for logs initially, then evaluating 90-day option.
- Pricing: interested in 12mo reserved Dedicated (discounted) with monthly burst pool; asked for explicit burst pricing and commitment tiers. Pricing deck in Drive.
- Quotes from infra lead: "We need deterministic tails — can't have region flapping during sales calls."
- Next practical steps: provisioning checklist (VPC, routes, KMS), confirm GPU sizes (A100 vs H100 tradeoffs), lock forecast for ARR calc.
- Risks: legal timeline (MSA delays), unclear burst pricing impact on unit economics, reliance on one region for initial POC.
- Stubs: see Drive pricing + POc plan. Fireflies links above. Jira tickets opened for VPC peering (INF-872) and KMS rotation testing (INF-893).
